title: Eskolx Labs: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Illuminated Codex. Keep it, take one of the three alternates, or re-roll.

options.label: The Illuminated Codex
options.thesis: One manuscript in two fields: a vellum folio and a night-loam binding, where every statistical tool is a rubricated entry and the 3-month cohort is a season of illumination.
options.viewport: An open folio on loam: the grapevine emblem grows up the left margin in ink, the mission set as a rubricated incipit in vermilion, the join as a seal at the foot.
options.risk: Sacred-book art risks reading as church relic rather than a live lab; the cohort CTA and instrument registers must pull it into the present.

raised.raise: One seed writes the whole codex: every leaf, chart, and margin is illuminated from a single generative grammar, so the page is visibly produced, not typeset.
No empty folios: every margin, border, and cell is fully inked and authored.
One rubric band: vermilion is held for the Join action alone on every leaf.

options.label: The Observatory Almanac
options.thesis: One almanac in two fields, a parchment day-spread and a loam night-spread, where every statistic is a measured entry in a seasonal table and the 3-month cohort is the year turning.
options.lineage: The grower's year is the codex's own calendar; closest to the field the brand already stands in, which is why it must not go unchallenged.
options.viewport: A day-spread centered: an engraved vine emblem tops the left column, the mission set in ruled rows, and a vermilion seal on the one action, Join the cohort.
options.risk: The grower's almanac is the familiar category standard for a botanical brand; the scrollytelling must push it past the expected cover.

options.label: The Collider Event Display
options.case: Holds product clarity: tracing one event through detector rings is the no-black-box story told as a single instrument. Loses identification: the growth of a package over a cohort is not a flash of collision.
options.thesis: Every statistical tool is a collision event you trace from the beamline through detector rings into calorimeter wedges; each method is a track, each test a bar.
options.viewport: A vertical dark slice fills the viewport: the beamline at the left edge, one event blooming as the vine, the mission as a steel-blue plate, a vermilion bar for Join.
options.risk: Instrument readouts read as generic dark-tech; the vine and the report sheet must keep the field rooted.

options.label: The Provenance Ribbon
options.case: Holds product clarity: lineage is the proof claim, a ribbon of where every line came from. Loses identification: builders do not see themselves in a museum register.
options.thesis: Every tool wears one continuous ribbon of its history: the paper it came from, the code that grew it, the tests that vetted it, the thread left unresolved.
options.viewport: A buff sheet, a red ribbon folding from the emblem, each fold dated and set, the join as the final un-woven weave.
options.risk: Reads as an archive rather than a working lab; the cohort call-to-action must stay live.

options.label: The One-Bit Desktop
options.case: Holds identification: builders know the desktop in their hands, and the two-ink dither holds the two fields. Loses clarity: the black-box story does not fit the chrome.
options.thesis: A desktop in two inks: parchment and loam, every tone dithered, windows over windows, the lab as a machine you operate with keys and ants.
options.viewport: A parchment desktop, two windows stacked, the mission window on top, a folder for each tool, the dock sealing the brand.
options.risk: Retro-UI is a loved rut with a low ceiling; the fields and the cohort must keep it out of the toy register.

options.label: The Rain-Garden
options.thesis: An impossible garden where every number falls to its own gravity and the cohort is a season of planting.
options.kept: One law writes the whole page: a single generative rule produces every leaf and chart.
options.risk: Poetry over instrument; the mechanism invisible.

options.label: The Lowbrow Gallery Panel
options.thesis: A crowded airbrushed tableau, every element outlined in black and lacquered; the lab as a hot-rod mural.
options.kept: No empty fields: every cell of the page is fully inked and outlined.
options.risk: The register fights the careful-craft story.

options.label: The Street Poster
options.thesis: A wall of shouting wood-type; the whole site is one architectural poster and the join is the one red band.
options.kept: One action band: vermilion held for the single CTA on every leaf.
options.risk: The shout sells the wrong promise for careful study materials.
